> **Security problem?** Do not open a public issue. Follow the [security policy](https://github.com/rj-nexus/rj-nexus/security/policy).
> Please search [existing issues](https://github.com/rj-nexus/rj-nexus/issues) first.

**Describe the bug**
A clear and short description of what is wrong.

**Where does it happen?**
- Page or admin section: [e.g. Admin → Posts → Edit, Media Library, public page /about]
- URL path: [e.g. /admin/posts/12/edit]
- RJBuilder widget (if any): [e.g. Prayer Times, Share, Timeline]
- Language (locale) in use: [e.g. en, az]

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. Scroll down to '...'
4. See error

**Expected behavior**
What you expected to happen.

**Actual behavior**
What happened instead. Include the exact error message if there is one.

**Screenshots or video**
If applicable, add them to help explain the problem.

**Environment**
- RJ Nexus version: [e.g. 1.11.1, see Admin → RJ About]
- Install type: [fresh install / updated from version ...]
- PHP version: [e.g. 8.3, run `php -v`]
- Node.js version: [e.g. 20.x, run `node -v`. Only needed for build or development problems]
- Database and version: [e.g. MySQL 8.0, MariaDB 10.6]
- Web server: [e.g. Apache, Nginx, LiteSpeed]
- Where it runs: [local (XAMPP, Laragon, Docker...) / shared hosting / VPS]
- Active theme and plugins: [names]

**Browser and device**
- OS: [e.g. Windows 11, macOS 14, Android 14, iOS 17]
- Browser and version: [e.g. Chrome 130, Safari 17, Firefox 132]
- Device: [desktop / phone / tablet, and model if it is a mobile problem]
- Happens in other browsers too? [yes / no]

**Logs**
Add any errors from:
- `storage/logs/laravel.log` (last lines)
- Browser console (press F12, then Console tab)

```
paste the log here
```

**Additional context**
Anything else that may help: when it started, what changed before it, whether it happens every time.
